title: docs(site): ship the English deck 'The Ontology Is the Software' as a vector PDF under apps/docs/public/decks
body:
Fixes #22253
Clause-②: no

One new binary, nothing else: the English deck "The Ontology Is the Software — How a large model reads an enterprise" as a PDF the docs site serves.

## What changed

| File | Change |
| :--- | :--- |
| `apps/docs/public/decks/the-ontology-is-the-software.pdf` | new: 17 pages, 1920 x 1080, 768,057 bytes, vector text with embedded fonts (Inter, IBM Plex Mono) |

Served at https://objectstack.ai/decks/the-ontology-is-the-software.pdf by the docs app, the same way `apps/docs/public/hero-cover-dark.webp` is served from the site root. No page links to it yet; where it is linked from is a separate maintainer decision (card body).

## How it was made

Printed by Chromium (`page.pdf`, one 1920 x 1080 page per slide, `printBackground`) from the deck's slide HTML, after the maintainer's byline ruling: the speaker name is replaced by "ObjectStack Team" on the cover and the closing slide, matching the blog essay's byline. Deck order: cover · what an enterprise is · one definition, never written down · the model knows everything except your company · a brilliant new hire on day one · when execution is nearly free · ontology, the study of what there is · where it lives once written down · who is building ontologies in 2026 · an ontology written clearly enough runs directly · what the runtime does with the definition · all three, now · an agent reads an enterprise in three steps · what an enterprise truly owns · the future enterprise · what you get · three sentences to take home.

## Checks

- No `packages/**`, `content/**`, `README.md`, app code or generated ledger touched; nothing publishes, so `skip-changeset`.
- `scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs` judges binary-ness by content and skips real binaries; the PDF is one.
- No model identifier in the PDF text, the commit or this body.
- Seat-executed under the maintainer's direct instruction (card body quotes it); the seat does not merge its own PR, so this stays a draft for the maintainer to land.
